subject: Hosted trial — ops alignment, endpoint plan & rate caps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@ledgerwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted trial — ops alignment, endpoint plan & rate caps

Hi Aisha — really appreciate you and the team joining the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get LedgerWise onto a hosted evaluation this week.

What we covered (high level):
- Hosted API quickstart endpoints (sandbox and staging) and how they map to your traffic (sync search + async batch reranks).
- Rate caps and burst behavior: how we enforce per-endpoint QPS and token-per-minute ceilings and what fallback looks like.
- Data isolation for trials and options for Dedicated/Private if you need stricter controls later.

Immediate asks / next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm the two traffic profiles you want in the trial: 1) low-latency user-facing generation (~50 QPS, 1k avg tokens) and 2) nightly batch rerank (10-20 concurrent jobs).
2) Give us a sample token budget you want to evaluate (suggestion: 50k tokens/day for initial 7-day pilot).
3) Provide the IP egress constraints (if you require a static egress allowlist for sandbox). If not needed, we’ll provision sandbox without it.
4) Sign the attached ops checklist (checklist includes required headers, sample payloads, and test dataset placement).

What Redwood will do after you confirm:
- Provision a sandbox + staging endpoint pair with default rate caps: 60 QPS / 10k tokens/minute, adjustable after we see traffic.
- Share a scoped demo recording and quick-runbook (attached).
- Assign Ben as your technical onboarding lead and Marissa as GTM contact for commercial questions.

If you want to push heavier traffic during the pilot we can temporarily raise the burst window, but we’ll want to validate model latency and KV cache behavior first. Let me know if the suggested token budget and profiles look right and whether you need a weekend-only ramp.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-minute call to lock down details.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-hosted-trial-ops-checklist.pdf, demo-recording-20261029.mp4
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@ledgerwise.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted trial — ops alignment, endpoint plan & rate caps

Thanks, Sergio — great session yesterday. Confirming LedgerWise's preference and a few clarifications below:

1) Traffic profiles: agree with the two profiles you listed. We have an expected peak of ~45 QPS for search (95th perc) and the batch rerank jobs will run overnight, ~15 jobs concurrently.
2) Token budget: start with 75k tokens/day for the first 5 days then we will scale up to 250k if latency/quality look good.
3) Egress/IP: we do need static egress IPs for our staging firewall (security policy). Can Redwood provide an allowlist for sandbox endpoints?
4) Data handling: we will send masked PII for the trial, but we need confirmation on log retention for sandbox — can you confirm logs are retained for 30 days and are accessible to us via the Console?

Also: can you enable an endpoint that uses the smaller quantized variant (if available) so we can compare latency/cost during the pilot?

If someone from your side can provision the sandbox with the static IPs and the two endpoints, we’ll kick off tests on Monday.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Khan
Head of ML Ops | LedgerWise
aisha.khan@ledgerwise.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted trial — ops alignment, endpoint plan & rate caps

Looping in ops notes and internal checklist items. Action items for us:
- Ben: provision sandbox + staging endpoints for RW-8421 with static egress IPs (LedgerWise firewall requires allowlist). Use region us-west-2. Labels: acct=ledgerwise, trial=RW-8421.
- Ben: default caps per Sergio are fine but set initial token/day soft limit to 75k and enable automatic scaling to 250k on manual approval. Add an annotation to the trial that burst increases require manual signoff.
- Sergio: prepare a short note for Legal/Procurement that trial data will be masked and logs retained 30 days — I'll confirm exact Console log export method with infra.

Ben — please include the quantized model variant endpoint (when available) in the sandbox mapping so LedgerWise can A/B test latency vs cost. Also attach the ops checklist to the provisioning ticket.

Marissa
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@ledgerwise.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-31T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted trial — ops alignment, endpoint plan & rate caps

Hi Aisha — I’ve started provisioning the sandbox and staging endpoints in us-west-2. Summary of what I set up: 
- Sandbox endpoint: sandbox-ledgerwise-usw2.redwood.ai (static egress: 34.201.22.45) — added to your allowlist.
- Staging endpoint: staging-ledgerwise-usw2.redwood.ai (no public egress constraint; used for performance runs).
- Rate caps: Sandbox / Staging default = 60 QPS; token ceiling set to 75k/day soft; burst window enabled up to 150k tokens/day but requires manual override from Marissa.
- Added model variants: "redwood-gpt-small-quant" and "redwood-gpt-standard"; both mapped to the sandbox for A/B.
- Logs: retention set to 30 days for trial; we also enabled Console access for LedgerWise under the email trials@ledgerwise.com.

Next steps for LedgerWise: please run a small smoke test hitting sandbox-ledgerwise-usw2.redwood.ai with these headers: x-rw-account: ledgerwise, x-rw-trial: RW-8421. I attached the ops checklist to the provisioning ticket and included the demo recording link in the ticket.

If you need higher sustained throughput during the trial, reply-all and request a temporary increase — we’ll perform a short load validation before we lift the soft caps.

Ben Carter
Technical Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
